about_the_game:
Her voice, weaving into your day. Invite 'Seo Arin,' the other heroine of "French Connection," into your daily life.

The moment your ordinary notification alert becomes her voice, your day turns into a heart-fluttering scene from "French Connection." From a refreshing voice to wake you up to a soft whisper to end your day, this pack contains five special voice tracks made just for you.

Now, you can hear Arin's voice closer than ever before.

[TRACK LIST]

  • Morning Call: Let Arin's bright and refreshing voice open up a wonderful new day.

  • Words of Encouragement: When you're feeling a bit tired, recharge your energy with a vibrant cheer from Arin.

  • Notification: From now on, feel as if Arin herself is delivering all your latest news.

  • Ringtone: Set a special ringtone with Arin's voice, a call meant just for you.

  • Goodnight Message: At the end of the day, welcome a peaceful night's rest with Arin's soft whisper.

※ This voice pack is available in Korean only.
